title: Quick Italian Bean Pie
description: A hearty, comforting Italian-inspired bean pie made with a flaky pie crust and flavorful cannellini beans.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cooked cannellini beans, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Pour the bean mixture into the pie crust.
Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
